name: shared-helper-catalog
goal: List only exported codebase-wide helpers, with real signatures from the selected commit.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Functions lists exported standalone helpers in shared utility modules at the selected commit. Types, schemas, class methods, private and feature-local functions are excluded; unused exported helpers remain eligible.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing catalog and viewport fixtures contained only one callable module. Extend those fixtures with non-callable and unknown metadata, multiple exports, no callers, and exact-commit history projection assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: b62e8899 fails the shared catalog assertion, all three viewport card cases, and exact-commit history helper metadata. Before screenshots inspected: non-callable units are incorrectly displayed as calls.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Exact-revision source exports enrich projection metadata. Shared utility callables become individually sorted cards linked to their owning entity; types, private helpers, classes and feature-local source stay out.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 0f7a9504: unchanged catalog/rendering tests, all three viewport checks and exact-commit history integration pass after failing at b62e8899. Screenshots preserved in /tmp/harness-helpers-after.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Reports workspace check passed: 596 tests, formatting, typecheck, lint, three builds and audit. All 30 related browser cases pass, with no unexpected browser diagnostics. Root formatting, typecheck, lint, kernel checks/build and 854 unit tests passed (25 live cases skipped). The full root check was interrupted during broader E2E after 13 passing cases, so full cross-platform verification remains pending; no native UI testing or main merge. Exact-commit history integration and immutable red/green pairs are recorded separately. Live preview 5688 verified helper search, schema exclusion and owner-history links. Cached projections were enriched from exact Git commits without changing prior records, media or other fields. Logs: /tmp/harness-helpers-reports-final-check.log, /tmp/harness-helpers-browser-final.log, /tmp/harness-helpers-root-check.log.
